title: Ask Self, Ask Others: Relation Is All You Need
abstract: arXiv:2608.20172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention directly derives normalized information flow from pairwise scores. We introduce Relation, an alternative token-mixing primitive that first organizes pairwise evidence into explicit Self and Exchange relations and derives information flow afterward. This relational organization gives rise to Full Relation, FlashRelation, Linear Relation, Hybrid Relation, and a KV-style Relation Cache. Across matched decoder-only models at approximately 10M, 30M, and 100M parameters, Full Relation achieves lower final validation NLL than MHA at all three scales. In a fixed-context reference benchmark, FlashRelation is 3.60-4.41x faster than the materialized Full Relation implementation. Across scale-matched production workloads, it reaches 76.4-84.9% of PyTorch FlashAttention throughput while executing the Full Relation operator. translated_title: 问自己，问他人：关系即一切
translated_abstract: 摘要：注意力机制直接从成对分数中导出归一化的信息流。我们引入了“关系”（Relation），一种替代性的标记混合原语，它首先将成对证据组织成明确的“自我”（Self）和“交换”（Exchange）关系，然后从中导出信息流。这种关系组织产生了全关系（Full Relation）、闪关系（FlashRelation）、线性关系（Linear Relation）、混合关系（Hybrid Relation）以及一种KV风格的关系缓存（KV-style Relation Cache）。在约1000万、3000万和1亿参数的匹配解码器专用模型中，全关系在所有三个规模上都实现了比多头注意力（MHA）更低的最终验证负对数似然（NLL）。在固定上下文参考基准测试中，闪关系比物化的全关系实现快3.60-4.41倍。在规模匹配的生产工作负载中，它达到了PyTorch FlashAttention吞吐量的76.4-84.9%，同时执行全关系算子。混合关系使用75%的线性关系层，并实现了强大的语言建模质量。这些结果支持了一种新的范式。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“关系”的标记混合原语，通过显式组织自我与交换关系来替代注意力机制，在多个参数规模下实现了更低的验证损失和更高的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Relation," a token-mixing primitive that organizes pairwise evidence into explicit Self and Exchange relations, achieving lower validation loss and higher efficiency across multiple model scales.
